displayName: [Preview]: Log Analytics workspace replicas should use allowed locations
description: Restrict the locations of Log Analytics workspace replicas to meet data residency and sovereignty requirements. A workspace with replication enabled is non-compliant when its replication location is missing or outside the allowed replica locations. Workspaces without replication enabled are compliant. The workspace's primary location is not evaluated.

metadata.description: The list of locations where Log Analytics workspace replicas are allowed.
Enable or disable the execution of the policy
